applicability: T031 bounded local-IPC-only tool gateway candidate
statement: If the gateway endpoint used any `AF_INET`/`AF_INET6`, DNS, resolver, or TLS facility, the tests **shall** fail closed; the gateway **shall** expose only host-protected local IPC (`AF_UNIX`/`socketpair`) and **shall** bind no TCP address.
title: T031 requirement 008
